land.text: Niue, a 261.46 km2 raised coral atoll

predecessors.note: Niue 'was brought within the boundaries of New Zealand on 11 June 1901', 'by the same Order and Proclamation as the Cook Islands'. The new-zealand dossier (oc-02-a) draws Niue within New Zealand from 1907 and as a client from 1974.

correction.text: Niue, 'a 261.46 km2 (100.95 sq mi) raised coral atoll'

keyframe_review.note: New keyframe (no Cliopatria row): the country Niue is cells: 1 (about 253 km2) against the page's 261.46 km2 (ratio about 1.0).

ledger.note: 1974: Niue becomes self-governing in free association with New Zealand: infobox 'Self-government in free association with New Zealand: 19 October 1974'; the page also says Niue has been self-governing 'since 3 September 1974, when the people endorsed the Constitution in a plebiscite'.

certainty.note: A single island; the border is the coast.

sources.title: Niue
sources.note: Document of 19 October 1900, brought within New Zealand's boundaries 11 June 1901, plebiscite 3 September 1974, self-government in free association 19 October 1974, area 261.46 km2, Alofi with coordinates.

notes: Written by oc-02-x. One page opened (Niue). The page dates the plebiscite to 3 September 1974 and gives 19 October 1974 only in the infobox as the self-government date; the dossier uses October. Earlier: a document dated 19 October 1900 in which the King and Chiefs 'consented to Queen Victoria taking possession of this island'; the page does not use the word annexed for Niue and says a British protectorate 'was declared, but it remained short-lived' without a year. The page is silent on Tokelau. The new-zealand dossier (oc-02-a) records Niue as a client (vassal_start 1974, counterpart niue); this dossier is the state it names.
